overview_description.description: Wyvern was created to unlock the secrets of the electromagnetic spectrum by providing groundbreaking access to high-resolution and quality imagery. The hyperspectral sensors on our Dragonette satellites will capture data in many narrow spectral bands, allowing for the identification of unique chemical and physical properties of the Earth's surface. This makes Wyvern's hyperspectral imagery data an extremely valuable tool for a wide range of site monitoring, mapping and geospatial intelligence (GEOINT) use-case applications.
